It defines core objects (Wheel, Hub, Spoke, Ozi, Advisors, Skills, Lugs, Sessions, Tracks), mailbox behavior, signal staging, PEV contract across Epic/Work/Test lugs, and smart update reconciliation between framework and spoke-local capabilities. It specifies folder structures, wakeup/status/closeout ceremonies, and versioning expectations...
files_out.excerpt: Wheelwright is a file-based AI continuity framework designed to preserve project memory, enforce protocol, and support reusable intelligence across projects. It is organized as a wheel: a hub that manages intelligence and spokes that execute work. The universal execution contract is PEV (Perceive, Execute, Verify) represented across Epic, Work, and Test lugs...
